data.title: Villa del Divos
data.about:
Villa del DIVOS at Dubai Islands, a 12-storey masterpiece by Mr. Eight Development, offers a unique blend of boutique residences and unparalleled luxury on Dubai Islands. With a collection of 96 apartments, including 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and 5-bedroom penthouses, each residence is designed to elevate living standards. Every apartment features a private pool, soaring ceiling heights, and interiors adorned with premium materials like Italian Calacatta Viola marble and custom wood finishes. 

The amenities redefine exclusivity, boasting a Rolls-Royce chauffeur service, a private motorboat with a captain, and a curated beach club. Residents also enjoy access to a wellness center with cryotherapy, steam rooms, and a yoga terrace, ensuring a holistic lifestyle that seamlessly blends elegance and comfort. With a payment plan that includes 65% on handover, Villa del DIVOS at Dubai Islands makes owning a slice of this opulence achievable. Designed to cater to the most discerning tastes, these collection residences by Mr. Eight is where exclusivity meets unmatched sophistication.

characteristics_module.title: Elegant Design, Exceptional Services at Villa del DIVOS, Dubai Islands
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Luxury Services: Enjoy exceptional facilities at Villa del DIVOS from Rolls-Royce chauffeur service to a private Italian Riva motorboat experience.
  • Private Pools in Every Unit: All 96 residences feature a private pool, offering ultimate privacy and relaxation.
  • Prime Location: Situated on Dubai Islands with easy access to Dubai’s key landmarks and vibrant lifestyle hubs.
  • Exceptional Amenities: World-class wellness facilities at at Villa del DIVOS Dubai Islands include an infinity pool, cryotherapy studio, yoga terrace, and private beach club access.
  • Branded Interiors: Luxurious finishes by renowned designers such as Antonio Citterio and Tom Dixon.
  • Sophisticated Living: Boutique-style living with valet parking, room service, and seamless maintenance. Stunning architectural design with starlight ceilings in select units.
  • Breathtaking Views: Villa del DIVOS at Dubai Islands offers unparalleled vistas, with residences featuring stunning sea views and iconic sights of the Burj Khalifa.

location_tile.title: Boutique Residences at an Iconic Location
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Villa del DIVOS at Dubai Islands offers a serene waterfront setting with unmatched connectivity to the city’s key destinations. It provides residents with both natural tranquility and urban vibrancy. With easy reach to Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubai Islands perfectly balances luxury living with unparalleled convenience, making it a coveted address in Dubai.

  • Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary - 5 minutes
  • Dubai Creek Harbour - 10 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai - 15 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport (DXB) - 20 minutes
  • Dubai Marina - 25 minutes
  • Palm Jumeirah - 30 minutes
  • Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC) - 35 minutes

more_info.answer: Villa del Divos is located on Dubai Islands, offering stunning sea views and proximity to iconic landmarks like Downtown Dubai and Dubai Creek Harbour.
